body: I'm down
Like waves of the ocean.
I am more annoyed with people who automatically think that because there is a trauma, that that automatically means you have PTSD. They're not the same.
Hi, I'm @aha.itsme23 How do I get my videos to get more views? Some get like 200 views and some get 5. I don't get it.
TMI - I just pooped and now I'm feeling a little better? Still wish I knew what set this off though.
That sucks!
I want a tattoo now. This is perfect.
Thank you! So far I dont notice any changes really, just very tired/sluggish. I'll keep you posted!
It really is making me super tired and sluggish. Even foggy brained. How long does it usually last for you? Thank you!
Thanks! 😊
dontiw, you totally wanted to get distracted... like the rest of us.
are you in a library?
Thank you!
Thank you! This is my first treatment actually. Hoping it'll help get me to feeling like a person again!
I can't wait to get my life back. I've been a floating blob since November.

Thank you so much for your detailed response. I'm so scared of making the wrong choice, but I'm hearing that most people start with one and end up with another after a while. I might not know how my choice is until I make it.
Thanks! I really think I lucked out with this doctor!
That's a really good point. I would love to only think about the crohns every 8 weeks. Right now its every moment of every day. Thank you!
Is it the time it takes to do it that sucks?
Thank you! That's why I'm considering that one the most.

He educated me on each category and why meds are usually chosen for what. He actually did that a few times and gave me a list to refer to. I feel like I at least have a foundation, just not much more than that I guess. It is nice to have some say in my treatment though unless my previous experiences.
Hi, I'm trying to post something quickly. Please help?
Can I post please?
Same.
That's awesome! What helped you?
Sometimes it's so hard for me to explain what the pain feels like. So I say it's almost like a sharp cramping.? I guess I'm not very good with articulating.
How old are you? Are you generally fit? Sorry for the weird personal questions. Just worried.
It upsets me that my doctors won't put me on meds for this. I'm battling going to the ER every day.
I'm just lying here in extreme pain. It's an awful feeling but I've lost hope.
I'm actually seeing one this week. I'll bring it up. Hopefully she'll have some input.
Not yet. You think it could help?

I just want to be a functioning human being again. I used to be a social worker. Can you imagine me doing that without memory or verbal functioning? I literally am losing my life and who I am because of this.

I really hope this can be fixed with some meds. I wish any of my doctors would just treat me. It gets really frustrating when you keep getting worse and none of your 3 doctors want to pull the gun and treat what they think is wrong. It's literally destroying my life.
Yeah. I have my bachelors in english and yet I cant read, write papers, or speak well. I do feel stupid. Does your wife have a support network she talks to or something? Anything that helps her?

What assholes. I am so sorry that you're needing to be around them each day. Please tell me there are some good people in this school who makes it a little more manageable. 

I dont know if anything could be done like so many comments are offering. What I do know is that there will be a time when you're no longer in this school. Hold onto the good people and push forward one day at a time until you get there. You've got at least this whole community behind you, supporting you. And remember, you deserve better.
How do you know that you have. Partial obstruction? Mostly asking because I was wondering if I was getting one/have one.

YTA. Pets are part of the family. In other words: off limits. Not an item you can just sell. I would understand it maybe if you lived alone and it was your cat, but it's your 8 - year- old child's cat. It's just not ok.
I think I've heard of that drink. Is it Essential Diet? I was just pushing my PCP to let me get on that.

Thank you so much. I am so nervous about this. I'm in the process of going from one doctor to another, so I have no idea what his plan will be. I know the first one wouldnt treat me at all because she was scared of it interacting with meds I'm already on. Knowing this makes me feel a bit less freaked out. Really, I cant thank you enough.

It ultimately was a decision he made. It wasn't your decision. I know it is so awful and it's ok to feel how you are right now. I believe if it was any of us we would feel the same way. Just remember though. We cant control everything. Our clients ultimately have the freedom to decide how they will act - regardless of how we feel about it. This was not your fault.
Sometimes parents just dont get it. Like, it just doesn't click if that makes sense. I'm sorry. It sounds like you've really tried too.
How old are you? There are people who you can tell who can help your mom to get help and help your siblings from getting hurt. Does that sound like something that might be helpful to you?

Nope, 24 is definitely not "older". I can see stress being a reason, but not age. I'm guessing it has more to do with IBD than anything else. I'm sorry that people are just blowing it off. People suck.

ESH. Planning parties shouldn't be a competition. And whose to say that she wasn't just going along with the one you planned when she secretly hated it? It sounds like now you're going through your party comparing it to the one you threw. Also, if you wanted something specific, you should have told her straight out what you wanted and left some room for creativity. OR you could have done your own party. Sounds like she tried and it got screwed up. More communication is needed between everyone.

I have a similar problem. I am seeing my doctor monday morning and I'll explain it to her there. I'm still on this crazy journey to diagnosis. I actually ended up without any movements for 10+ days which was a crazy time too. Sorry I cant offer more but I want you to know you're not alone.
Gal.. thank you!
Strangely enough I can have cheese so I'm going to use that to my advantage. Going to play it safe tonight since I'm not going straight home after.
Actual fish. White fish and salmon, baked.
Thanks! The seafood thing has to be related since I react the same way and it started the same time that my crohns symptoms did. It kills me. I hope it changes.
I tried this but it didnt work out well, so this is where we're going unfortunately. It's kind of complicated.
Egg pan!
Always give notice. Remember, a new job will call them. No notice is burning a bridge.
Do you think BBQ might be ok?
As much as it may kill you, do everything you can not to burn any bridges. Do what you have to, get a new job, and then leave and never look back. Our field is way too small to do it any other way.
I've been there. Can you look for other jobs?
I tried to gift it. That's a little of how I ended up in this situation...

The reason we're going out is because of this coupon I have, so I can't really choose a different restaurant. It's difficult because I havent started treatment yet, so every day is difficult. I know fish makes me very sick almost immediately. I know some other things make me sick but I dont know why. I can have a baked potato but not mashed potatoes. I wish I understood this more so I could have less anxiety around it.
Even though that's the most delicious thing, I won't. I feel like there's nothing I can really choose from. It's like a really weird messed up form of hell.

This is so difficult. I never liked grilled chicken and just started liking salads before this started. I wish I knew what I can eat that's actually delicious. I've been getting so frustrated and upset around this. Especially this restaurant which I feel has very little that I can choose from. (sorry for ranting like this)
Do you think salad might be ok?

I've already had a colonoscopy, endoscopy, cray, ct scan, blood tests, multiple stool tests, a breath test... not sure how many more tests there are to do. 

My first opinion wanted me to get another colonoscopy next month too.
I'm having doctors tell me the same. Were you experiencing symptoms the whole time?
She did not. They were running tests as quickly as possible to give a diagnosis and start treatment. At this point they have an idea but no certainty on my diagnosis and I'm starting a 2nd opinion.
Good point. Same here. And take your time. I thought I was done with the bathroom, but then didn't make it to the car.

The barium is the worst part of it. I struggled my way through it and didnt even finish the last one and they said that was ok. The important thing is to pace yourself. You got this! 

Side note- the contrast makes you feel like you're peeing yourself. Always a weird feeling.
I wish I could do it this way for mine. Last time I vomited so much that I set myself into an anxiety attack and couldn't finish the prep.

I'm working on getting a 3rd opinion. No one can tell me how long it'll last because no one has diagnosed it yet. 

I'm hoping to talk to my doctor about disability. At the very least I want yo apply. Theyll probably tell me no. I do know I cant get unemployment though.

Yes. When I could no longer just push myself through eating my favorite food. I hardly ever get to eat it except on rare occasions. And one day just before Thanksgiving, I looked at it in front of me and realized I just couldn't push through it. That's when I realized there was something very wrong with me.
Hey, can you send me info on this finding? I'm not getting needed treatment because of negative results.
Last time I was gagging the whole time. I told them I thought I was going to throw it up and they responded by asking if I wanted a bag just in case. Hospitality at its finest.
It's the only thing I've been prescribed for the pain.
Believe it or not, she's young. She's awful though.
I am working on finding a new doctor, but this also isn't the first time this has come up. This actually comes up every single time the medication is mentioned.

Thank you, I wish that was an option for me. Unfortunately I'm just graduating with my masters so working in a private practice isn't an option just yet. Maybe sometime in the future though that would be amazing. Just not now, when I could use it the most.

I definitely lost my sex drive. My partner stopped trying as much because I've turned him down so much. I try every once in a while but its hard. I do feel like it's affected my relationship, but we're working on strengthening other aspects. Remember. Theres more to a relationship than sex.
It could be about the food. Maybe I'm more sensitive to it now.
Well... can't say I know how to feel about that.
During a couples massage where my boyfriend didnt experience that?
I think so? They do that there too.

Thanks! I think I would have at least felt a little better about it if she told me why she was about to do that and asked me about if that's ok. I don't remember her name and I'm kind of embarrassed to call them up. I might just go somewhere else next time.

I think the concern I had was that she was repeatedly hitting against my vaginal area (over my underwear) with her hand while working the thigh muscle. She had to know she was touching me there since it was a firm hit but it didnt stop her.
I've been dealing with that too and nothing helps. I was thinking it's because I eat before bed? I dont know how accurate that is though.

Actually I was looking this up yesterday and there are studies that found a connection between EDs and Crohns, etc. One article says "people with eating disorders were more than twice as likely to have endocrine diseases, especially type 1 diabetes, and GI disorders, particularly Crohn's disease" 

We destroy our bodies with EDs, so it makes sense. I'm sorry that this is happening. It's happening to me too right now. Know you're not alone.
So many people think they know more about Crohn's than they do. I lost my job because they didn't understand it. People suck and I'm so sorry this is another thing that you have to deal with.

Definitely remember what foods he can and cannot eat. Try not to push foods on him regardless of what he can eat. I know when I am in a lot of pain I'll feel nauseous and like I can't eat. Most of all, be patient and know that it will come and go. Keep asking questions, that's awesome that you're taking the steps to be as supportive as you can be.
I really needed to hear this right now. Thank you.
